name: PromptPotter-self
description: Optimizer-of-the-optimizer — outer PromptPotter cycle mutates inner PromptPotter's L1/L1_CRITIQUE/L2/L3 meta-prompts. Each outer 'sample' runs an inner cycle on a cheap proxy benchmark (configured per inner_tasks.json). See docs/specs/m12-promptpotter-as-connector.md.

l1_generate.description: Inner cycle's L1-generate meta-prompt — produces inner candidate variants from inner panels (parent_baseline, sibling_yield, escalation_panel, axis_memory).

prompt_meta.description: Six-field PromptTemplate scheme — outer L1 mutates these to evolve the inner L1's behavior.

l1_critique.description: Inner cycle's L1-critique meta-prompt — narrates score deltas and proposes negative_critique + suggested_axes.

prompt_meta.description: Critique framing controls how the inner L1 rewards or penalizes specific axes.

l2_context.description: Inner cycle's L2 meta-prompt — refines task_context on inner-L1 stall.

prompt_meta.description: L2 refinement framing — outer L1 mutates how the inner L2 shapes task_context.

l3_plan.description: Inner cycle's L3 meta-prompt — replans strategy on inner-L2 stall.

prompt_meta.description: L3 replan framing — outer L1 mutates how the inner L3 rewrites the plan-space.
